2610.12325.title: Prior or Feedback? What an LLM Uses When Adapting Neural Operators
2610.12325.paper_summary: Do LLM scientific agents rely only on their initial task context, or do they adapt their decisions in response to experimental feedback? We study this question in neural operator adaptation, where a large language model (LLM) selects fine-tuning configurations under a limited trial budget. Across transfers within and between partial differential equation (PDE) families, the LLM achieves lower held-out test nRMSE than random search and Bayesian optimisation in nearly every matched comparison. Endpoint performance alone cannot distinguish what happens, so we verify each attribution with controlled interventions. Before observing any validation score, the LLM's first configuration already ranks near the top of the corresponding random-search pool, indicating a useful initial bias. A complementary cold-start intervention shows that the selected base learning rate shifts with the PDE description. Once feedback becomes available, reassigning validation scores among evaluated configurations changes the next proposal in every case tested, whereas a value-preserving rewrite produces no comparable aggregate effect. These interventions establish that the LLM's decision-level actions respond to the given task and observed outcomes, showing that it combines a task-dependent prior with sensitivity to experimental feedback.
2610.12325.paper_summary_zh: LLM 科學代理僅依賴其初始任務上下文，還是會根據實驗反饋調整其決策？我們在神經運算元適應中研究這個問題，這裡一個大型語言模型（LLM）在有限的試驗預算下選擇微調配置。在部分微分方程（PDE）家族內部和之間的轉移中，LLM 在幾乎每個匹配比較中都實現了比隨機搜索和貝葉斯優化更低的保留測試 nRMSE。僅僅依賴最終性能無法區分發生了什麼，因此我們通過控制干預來驗證每個歸因。在觀察到任何驗證分數之前，LLM 的第一個配置已經在相應的隨機搜索池中排名接近頂部，這表明存在有用的初始偏見。一個互補的冷啟動干預顯示，所選的基學習率隨著 PDE 描述而變化。一旦反饋可用，重新分配評估配置之間的驗證分數會在每個測試案例中改變下一個提案，而保持值的重寫則不會產生可比的總體效果。這些干預確立了 LLM 的決策級行動對給定任務和觀察結果的反應，顯示它結合了任務依賴的先驗和對實驗反饋的敏感性。
2610.12325.author: Julian Chan et.al.
